highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds modern .NET UWP controls and experimental image comparison, alongside rendering and crash fixes.
highlights_body: Runtime-effect uniforms start at zero, GPU texture subsets avoid sampling exterior texels, and Windows x64 image error recovery is corrected. Linux x86 native assets are no longer included.

breaking.title: Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture
breaking.body: Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Applications relying on those assets must move to a supported architecture before upgrading.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Views.UWP adds CPU SKXamlCanvas and ANGLE-backed SKSwapChainPanel controls for net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0, declaring Windows 10.0.17763.0 as the OS minimum. SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.UWP supplies UWP integration assets for x86, x64 and ARM64. This does not restore legacy uap10.0 support.

SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and produces difference images. The separate managed-only package requires opting into experimental diagnostic SKIA4001; returned difference images belong to the caller.

Fixes process crashes when libjpeg or libpng recovers from decoding errors in clang-built Windows x64 natives, including malformed JPEGs passed to SKCodec.Create and PDF output using lazy non-JPEG images. ARM64, x86 and MSVC builds are unchanged.
New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers are zero-initialized, and Reset clears the existing buffer rather than allocating a replacement. Effect and mesh users no longer start with leftover uniform data.
Ganesh bilinear sampling clamps slightly inside texture subsets to avoid including undefined exterior texels. Texture-edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected by this option.
Applies Tizen's intended blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ.
Replaces the string-path Window binding with a statically expressed binding, removing the associated trimming warning when constructing SKGLView without changing its intended behavior.
Updates the bundled m159 engine to the merged upstream bug-fix set. This same-milestone sync introduces no managed binding changes of its own.

contributor_summaries.taublast: Zero-initialized runtime-effect uniforms, allocation-free uniform reset, and disposal of test data snapshots.
contributor_summaries.bhall-ctre: Trim-safe Window binding for MAUI SKGLView.
contributor_summaries.FoggyFinder: Modern .NET UWP controls, native integration and packaged drawing samples.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery and its views projects to the Windows sample solution.
contributor_summaries.SimonCropp: Windows x64 crash fix for libjpeg and libpng error recovery.
